sections.kicker: Prepared for Atelier Bianca by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Instagram sounds like a seamstress. The new site sounds like a shop.
sections.keep: Your bio line, "Ti chiederanno dove hai preso i tuoi vestiti." It is a promise only a made to measure atelier can make.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.what: The new site opens like any online store.
pins.why: It answers the feeling that something is off: the site talks like a shop while Instagram talks like Carlotta at the bench.
pins.how: Open the site in your own voice, with the atelier and the fitting, not the store.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: Visitors meet a shop with no name behind it and compare prices with every other shop.

pins.quote: Ti chiederanno dove hai preso i tuoi vestiti
pins.what: Your best promise lives only in the Instagram bio.
pins.why: It says why Bianca and not a rack: clothes people ask about.
pins.how: Make it the first line people read on the site.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: The line that earns the order never reaches the people who land on the site.

pins.what: Made to measure shows up as a status line.
pins.why: Tailoring to one body is the reason to choose an atelier over fast fashion, and it reads like opening hours.
pins.how: Name the made to measure service as the core of Bianca, on both front doors.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: The service that sets you apart looks like a footnote.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at Atelier Bianca. You said something feels off and a new website did not fix it. I think I can name it.
